name: Coffee Shop POS UAT
instructions:
What we're testing
The café / restaurant POS that restaurants get through GreenCard. Two parts:
• The SaaS admin (admin.<POS site>): Ralfiz creates restaurants, sets plans, prices, hardware, invoices and payments, and can pause a restaurant.
• Each restaurant's own POS (<name>.<POS site>): menu, tables and QR ordering, kitchen, billing, cash, reports.

Roles inside a restaurant
• Super Admin = owner. Everything, including Settings and Outlets.
• Outlet Manager: menu categories, users, reports for their outlet.
• Cashier: Billing Counter, Collections, Cash Drawer, Sales Reports.
• Waiter: Floor Map, orders, waiter app (/waiter/).
• Kitchen Staff: Kitchen Display.
Guests need no login: they scan the table QR to order and pay.

Order
1. Getting started: everyone.
2. Setup: Sana, on the SaaS admin and the uat_owner login. Everything else stays locked until it's done.
3. Then everyone tests their own sections at the same time.
4. Last day: role checks, reports and the full café day together.

Rules for testing together
• Test only in UAT Café (uatcafe) unless a test names another restaurant. Never touch Corner Café.
• Order only the starter menu items from setup. Don't edit or delete them.
• Start anything new you create with your initial: S - , F - , M - .
• Change Settings only in your own Settings tests, and put them back.
• Online payments use Razorpay TEST keys: no real money. Test card/UPI details are on the logins sheet.

How to mark
• Pass: it did what 'Should happen' says.
• Fail: it did something wrong. Write what you did and saw, add a screenshot.
• Blocked: you couldn't test it (error page, missing data, no printer).
• Chrome on a laptop for staff screens; your phone for QR ordering and paying.

tests.title: Sign in with a password
steps: Open the UAT Café address from the logins sheet → /login/. Sign in with your role login.
tests.expected: You land on the Dashboard. The sidebar shows only the items for your role (see the role list at the top of this plan).

tests.title: Sign in with a PIN
steps: Sign out. Open /pin-login/ and type your 6-digit PIN.
tests.expected: Signed in as the same person.

tests.title: Change your password
steps: Header → My Profile → change password. Try 'abc123' first, then a proper one of 8+ characters.
Sign out and in with the new one.
tests.expected: Short password refused. The new one works; the old one doesn't. Tell Sana your new password is set (not the password itself).

tests.title: Wrong login
steps: Sign in with a wrong password, then a wrong PIN.
tests.expected: Clear error, nothing else revealed.

tests.title: SaaS admin sign-in
steps: Open the SaaS admin address → sign in with the SaaS admin login.
tests.expected: Overview page with the top menu: Overview · Restaurants · Plans · Invoices · Payments · Activity, and a Settings chip.

tests.title: Company settings
steps: Settings: company name, GSTIN (test, e.g. 32ABCDE1234F1Z5, state Kerala), bank, UPI ID, invoice prefix 'RT', GST 18%, payment terms 7 days, support phone and email. Save.
tests.expected: Saved. The Overview no longer shows a 'settings missing' prompt.

tests.title: Create UAT Café
steps: Restaurants → New.
1 Business: name 'UAT Café', address 'uatcafe'.
2 Plan & billing: Enterprise, No expiry.
3 Owner login: username 'uat_owner', password from the logins sheet.
4 Address & GST: a test GSTIN; check state and PAN fill in. Save.
tests.expected: UAT Café is listed as Active. Its address opens the POS sign-in page. uat_owner can sign in and lands on the owner dashboard with charts.

tests.title: Online payment test keys
steps: Restaurants → UAT Café → Online payments → Set up. Key ID and Key Secret: the Razorpay TEST keys from the logins sheet. UPI ID and name shown in UPI apps. → Test keys → Save.
tests.expected: 'Test keys' says they work. A webhook URL and webhook secret are shown. In the POS (as owner) Settings → Payment Gateway shows read-only details with a test-mode notice.

tests.title: Business, tax and bill text
steps: As uat_owner → Settings.

Business: name, phone, address, logo. Tax & Billing: CGST 2.5%, SGST 2.5%, service charge 0. Outlet Settings: receipt header and footer, order prefix, Enable tax calculation ticked, Allow QR Code Ordering ticked, QR order protection 'Table code, else staff confirms'. Save each tab.
tests.expected: Each tab says saved and keeps the values after a reload.

tests.title: Starter menu
steps: Cafe Menu → Add Category: 'Coffee', 'Food', 'Desserts'.
Add Item: Cappuccino ₹120, Cold Coffee ₹150 (Coffee); Veg Sandwich ₹140, Chicken Burger ₹180 (Food); Brownie ₹90 (Desserts).
Cappuccino → Variants & Add-ons: variants Regular/Large (+₹30); add-on group 'Extras' (Optional, multi-select): Extra shot ₹30, Oat milk ₹40.
tests.expected: All 5 items show as available with the right prices. Cappuccino shows its variants and add-ons when ordering.

tests.title: Tables and floor
steps: Floor Map → Add Floor 'Ground'. Add Table: T1, T2, T3, T4 (4 seats each) on Ground.
tests.expected: 4 tables shown as Vacant, each with a QR code.

tests.title: Kitchen stations
steps: Kitchen Stations → Add Station 'Barista' (no printer IP) and 'Kitchen' (no printer IP). Make Kitchen the default.
Category routing: Coffee → Barista; Food and Desserts → Kitchen. Save routing.
tests.expected: Saved. Both stations show as display-only.

tests.title: Staff logins
steps: Users → Add User four times: uat_manager (Outlet Manager), uat_cashier (Cashier), uat_waiter (Waiter), uat_chef (Kitchen Staff). Passwords and PINs from the logins sheet.
Try giving uat_chef the same PIN as uat_waiter.
tests.expected: All four created and active. Duplicate PIN refused ('This PIN is already in use…').

tests.title: Opening cash
steps: As uat_cashier → Cash Drawer → Open Drawer with ₹2,000.
tests.expected: Drawer is open with ₹2,000 expected balance.

tests.title: Add, edit and hide an item
steps: As uat_owner → Cafe Menu → Add Item 'S - Lemon Tea' ₹60 in Coffee. Edit to ₹70. Mark Unavailable.
tests.expected: Shows ₹70. When unavailable it can't be ordered from the POS or the guest QR menu. Mark Available again.

tests.title: Required add-on group
steps: Add-Ons → Add Group 'S - Milk', Required, single choice: Dairy ₹0, Oat ₹40. Attach to 'S - Lemon Tea'.
Order 'S - Lemon Tea' from the POS without picking a milk.
tests.expected: The order won't add the item until a milk is chosen. Oat adds ₹40.

tests.title: Manager's menu rights
steps: As uat_manager → Cafe Menu. Add a category 'S - Specials'. Then try Add Item, Edit an item, and Mark Unavailable.
tests.expected: Manager can add and edit categories. Item add/edit/availability are refused with a message (owner only).

tests.title: Add, edit and delete a table
steps: Floor Map → Add Table 'S - T9'. Edit seats to 6. Delete it.
tests.expected: Each step works; the table disappears after delete.

tests.title: QR cards
steps: Tables → Print QR cards. Pick tent layout, Headline 'Scan to order', Wi-Fi name. Print / Save as PDF. Then sticker layout.
tests.expected: The PDF has one card per table, with the café name, logo, table number and a QR that opens that table's order page on a phone.

tests.title: Regenerate a QR
steps: Table T4 → scan its QR on your phone (keep the page). Back on the laptop: Regenerate QR. Scan the old printed/saved QR again.
tests.expected: The old QR no longer works (not found). The new QR works.

tests.title: Merge tables
steps: As uat_waiter → Floor Map → Merge tables T3 and T4. Take an order on the merged table. After paying, unmerge.
tests.expected: One order/bill covers both tables; both show occupied; both are free after payment.

tests.title: Waiter takes an order
steps: As uat_waiter → Floor Map → T1 → take order: 2 Cappuccino (one Large with Extra shot), 1 Veg Sandwich → Send 3 to Kitchen.
tests.expected: Order is created for T1; table shows Ordering/Preparing. The Cappuccinos go to the Barista station and the sandwich to Kitchen.

tests.title: Kitchen display flow
steps: As uat_chef → Kitchen Display. Station filter Kitchen. Start Preparing on the sandwich, then Bump (Ready).
Station filter Barista: do the same for the coffees.
tests.expected: Each ticket moves Pending → Preparing → Ready to Serve without reloading. 'Waiting on other stations' shows until both stations are done. The waiter gets a ready notification.

tests.title: Serve
steps: As uat_waiter → the T1 order → Mark as Served.
tests.expected: Order is Served; the floor map shows T1 as Ready to Serve/served state, and 'Process Payment' becomes available to the cashier.

tests.title: Second round on the same table
steps: Add 1 Brownie to the T1 order → Send 1 to Kitchen.
tests.expected: Only the brownie goes to the kitchen. Earlier items stay served. The bill now includes the brownie.

tests.title: Priority and recall
steps: Make a new order on T2. In the Kitchen Display set it to Rush, Bump it, then Recall.
tests.expected: Rush orders stand out and sort first. Recall brings it back from Ready.

tests.title: Void an item
steps: On the T2 order, as uat_waiter try to void an item already sent to the kitchen. Then as uat_cashier void it.
tests.expected: The waiter can't void a sent item; the cashier can. The kitchen gets a CANCELLED ticket. The bill drops by that item.

tests.title: Add to bill only and parcel leftovers
steps: On T2 add a Brownie with 'Add to bill only'. Then 'Parcel leftovers' for the sandwich.
tests.expected: The 'bill only' brownie is billed but no kitchen ticket. Parcel makes a PARCEL ticket and adds no charge.

tests.title: Cancel an unpaid order
steps: Make an order on T3, don't pay. Cancel Order. Then try to cancel an order that has a part payment (after BIL-03).
tests.expected: Unpaid order cancels and frees T3. The part-paid one is refused: 'Cannot cancel a paid order. Process refund first.'

tests.title: Waiter app
steps: On your phone open <UAT Café>/waiter/ and sign in as uat_waiter. Tables → T4 → take an order → Send to Kitchen. Orders → open it.
tests.expected: The app works on the phone; the order appears in the Kitchen Display and on the laptop.

tests.title: Waiter app offline
steps: In the waiter app turn on aeroplane mode, take an order, then turn the network back on.
tests.expected: It says 'Offline Mode - Orders will sync when back online' and the order appears once back online, only once (no duplicate).

tests.title: Guest orders from the table
steps: Scan T2's QR on your phone (signed out). Order now → 'One bill for the table'. Add a Cold Coffee → submit.
tests.expected: Asked for the 4-digit table code (protection is 'Table code, else staff confirms'). Waiting screen until it's entered.

tests.title: Table code
steps: Staff: Tables → T2 → note the Table code. Guest: type a wrong code twice, then the right one.
tests.expected: Wrong code refused. Right code sends the order: it appears in the Kitchen Display and on the order list for T2.

tests.title: Staff confirms the guest
steps: Use a second phone (or incognito) on T2, order a Brownie and choose staff confirmation instead of the code.
On the staff dashboard the pop-up 'New QR order · Table T2' appears → Guest is here.
tests.expected: Pop-up shows; after 'Guest is here' the order goes to the kitchen. With 'Not at table' it is not sent.

tests.title: Call waiter
steps: Guest taps Call waiter twice quickly.
tests.expected: Staff see 'Table T2 is calling a waiter' with 'On my way'. The second tap within 90 seconds is held back with a message.

tests.title: Separate seat bills
steps: On T3 from two phones: 'Sharing the table with others? Get a separate bill' → each picks a different seat and orders.
tests.expected: Each guest sees only their own items and bill. Staff see one table with items by seat; Split by seat is possible at payment.

tests.title: Order limits
steps: Try 21 of one item in one line; then over 60 items in one round.
tests.expected: Both are refused with a clear message.

tests.title: Track the order
steps: Guest taps Track while the kitchen moves the order to Preparing and Ready.
tests.expected: The status page updates to match the kitchen.

tests.title: QR ordering off
steps: Owner → Settings → Outlet Settings: untick Allow QR Code Ordering. Guest scans a table QR. Tick it again.
tests.expected: Guest is told ordering isn't available; can still view the menu if offered. Works again after re-enabling.

tests.title: Table code changes after freeing
steps: Note T2's code. Pay and free T2. Look at the code again.
tests.expected: A new code is shown. The old one no longer works for a new guest.

tests.title: Print the bill for guests
steps: The T1 order (from ORD-04) → Print bill for guests.
tests.expected: The print page shows café name/logo, items with variants and add-ons, CGST + SGST, total, receipt header/footer, and a pay QR. Prices and tax add up.

tests.title: Cash at the Billing Counter
steps: As uat_cashier → Billing Counter → Open bills → T1 → Cash. Amount received ₹1,000 → Confirm Cash.
tests.expected: Change is right. 'Bill closed and table freed'. T1 is Vacant. Order is Completed.

tests.title: Part payment
steps: Order on T2 for about ₹400. Billing Counter: pay ₹200 by Card. Then the rest by Cash.
tests.expected: After ₹200: 'Part payment: the rest stays on this bill', with ₹200 still due. After the rest, the bill closes.

tests.title: UPI at the counter (test)
steps: New order → Process Payment → UPI. Scan the QR with your phone and pay using Razorpay test details.
Do one more and use 'Manually Confirm Payment' instead.
tests.expected: After the test payment the screen moves on by itself ('Waiting for payment…' ends). Manual confirm also closes the bill.

tests.title: Guest pays online with a tip
steps: Scan the pay QR on a printed bill (or open the guest's Pay button). Pick tip 10% → pay with Razorpay test card.
tests.expected: 'Payment successful', Download receipt works. The bill is closed in the Billing Counter; the tip shows under Collections → tips for the waiter who served.

tests.title: Split by seat
steps: Take the T3 seat-bill order from QR-05 → Process Payment → Split → Pay separately by seat number.
tests.expected: Each seat's amount is right; paying both closes the order.

tests.title: Customer display
steps: Billing Counter → Open (customer display) in a second window. Pick a bill.
tests.expected: The second window shows the bill and the pay QR for the guest.

tests.title: Pay before the food is ready
steps: New order still Preparing → take full payment.
tests.expected: Payment is taken, the table is freed, and the kitchen can still finish the order. Note whether this is what the café wants.

tests.title: Tax off at the outlet
steps: Owner → Settings → Outlet Settings → untick Enable tax calculation. Make an order and print the bill. Tick it again.
tests.expected: No tax on the bill. (Known risk: the global rates may still be used — mark Fail if tax appears.)

tests.title: Discount on a café bill
steps: Try to give 10% off on a café order from order detail or the Billing Counter.
tests.expected: Known gap: there's no discount button for café orders. Mark Blocked with 'no discount option' so the client can decide if it's needed.

tests.title: Start a shift
steps: As uat_cashier → Start shift with opening balance ₹2,000.
tests.expected: Shift started. (If the drawer were closed it would say 'Cash Drawer Not Open'.)

tests.title: Cash in and out
steps: Cash Drawer → Cash In ₹500 'change from bank'; Cash Out ₹200 'milk'.
tests.expected: Both listed in History; expected balance = opening + cash sales + 500 − 200.

tests.title: End shift and close drawer
steps: Do this on the last day. End shift: type an actual cash count ₹50 less than expected. Close Drawer.
tests.expected: Variance shows −₹50. Shift History lists the shift. Sales Reports → My Recent Shifts shows it.

tests.title: Expenses
steps: As uat_owner → Expenses → Manage Categories: add 'S - Supplies'. Add Expense ₹350 in it with a note. View All Expenses.
tests.expected: The expense is listed with the right date, category and amount.

tests.title: Stock items
steps: Inventory → Categories: 'S - Dairy'. Items: 'S - Milk' unit litre, stock 20, low-stock alert 5.
tests.expected: Item listed with 20 litres.

tests.title: Purchase order
steps: Inventory → Suppliers: add 'S - Milma'. Purchase Orders → create for S - Milma, 10 litres of S - Milk → mark sent → Receive.
tests.expected: After receiving, stock is 30 and Stock Movements shows +10.

tests.title: Adjust and alert
steps: Adjust S - Milk down to 4 (reason 'spoilt').
tests.expected: Stock 4; an Alert appears for low stock. Resolve it.

tests.title: Retail sale with QR pay
steps: As uat_cashier → Retail POS. Add a retail product (owner adds 'S - Coffee Powder 250g' ₹220 under Retail → Products first), 10% discount, pay by UPI/QR and scan on your phone.
tests.expected: Sale saved with the discount; the QR opens a pay page for this sale; after test payment it shows paid. It appears in Retail Sales and Collections.

sections.name: Reports & points (do on the last day)

tests.title: Reports page
steps: As uat_owner → Reports. Check Revenue Trend, Orders by Hour, Top Selling Items, Payment Methods, Order Types.
tests.expected: Numbers match the orders made during UAT (count Cappuccinos sold by hand and compare).

tests.title: Collections and PDF
steps: Collections → Day. Then Month. Download PDF.
tests.expected: Totals by method (cash, card, UPI, online) match the payments made; tips by staff shown; the PDF matches the screen.

tests.title: Cashier sales report
steps: As uat_cashier → Sales Reports → Today / This Week.
tests.expected: Shows only this cashier's sales and shifts.

tests.title: Staff points
steps: As uat_waiter → Points. As owner → Points → Adjust Points +10 for uat_waiter.
tests.expected: Points earned from completed orders are shown; the adjustment appears in My History.

tests.title: Send a notification
steps: Owner → Send Notification → By Role: Waiter, 'Team meeting at 4'.
tests.expected: uat_waiter sees it in the bell; uat_chef doesn't.

tests.title: Each role's sidebar
steps: Sign in as each of uat_owner, uat_manager, uat_cashier, uat_waiter, uat_chef and screenshot the sidebar.
tests.expected: Owner: everything incl. Settings, Outlets, Expenses. Manager: no Settings/Outlets/Expenses. Cashier: Billing Counter, Collections, Cash Drawer, Sales Reports. Waiter: Orders, Floor Map, Cafe POS. Kitchen: Kitchen Display.

tests.title: Typing hidden addresses
steps: As uat_waiter type: /kitchen/, /billing/, /settings/, /users/, /reports/, /expenses/.
As uat_chef type: /billing/, /orders/, /users/.
tests.expected: Each is refused or sends you back. (Known risk: some pages like /kitchen/ may open — mark Fail with the address.)

tests.title: Waiter can't take payment
steps: As uat_waiter open an order and look for Process Payment / Cancel Order. Also type <order address>/payment/.
tests.expected: No payment or cancel option for the waiter, and the address is refused.

tests.title: Manager can't make admins
steps: As uat_manager → Users → Add User with role Super Admin, then Outlet Manager.
tests.expected: Refused: 'You cannot create admin users.'

tests.title: Deactivated user
steps: Owner → Users → Deactivate uat_chef. Chef tries password and PIN login. Activate again.
tests.expected: Can't sign in while deactivated; can after.

tests.title: Restaurants are kept apart
steps: Try uat_owner on the Corner Café address and on the SaaS admin address.
Open a UAT Café table QR address but change the host to another restaurant.
tests.expected: All refused / not found. One restaurant's logins, tables and bills never work on another's address.

tests.title: Plans
steps: Plans → open Pro. Look at each section: Name & price, Offer, Modules, Limits, Availability (trial days), Hardware. Don't change Basic/Pro/Enterprise.
Plans → New: 'S - Mini', ₹499/month, 2 months free yearly, modules QR ordering + Kitchen display, limits 1 outlet / 3 staff / 5 tables, trial days 7. Save.
tests.expected: Saved. 'S - Mini' shows in the plan list and on GreenCard's POS plans page with a 7-day trial.

tests.title: Offer
steps: S - Mini → Offer: 20% off, Monthly only, ends next month. Save.
tests.expected: The offer price shows on the plan and on GreenCard; yearly price is unchanged.

tests.title: Hardware catalogue and EMI
steps: Plans → Hardware: add 'S - Tablet' ₹12,000 one-time, Split over 12 months. Add it to S - Mini as an Add-on.
tests.expected: GreenCard shows it on S - Mini as '+₹1,000/month × 12 (₹12,000 in total)'.

tests.title: Invoice and payment
steps: Restaurants → UAT Café → New invoice: 1 month, price ₹4,999. Save and print (?print=1).
Record a payment of half the amount by UPI.
tests.expected: Number like RT/26-27/0001; CGST+SGST for a Kerala restaurant; amount in words. After the part payment the invoice shows the balance due. Note: the paid-until date jumps to the invoice end even on part payment (check it's acceptable).

tests.title: Cancel an invoice
steps: Make a second invoice and Cancel it. Try to cancel the part-paid one.
tests.expected: The unpaid one cancels (its number is not reused). The part-paid one can't be cancelled.

tests.title: Hardware given to a restaurant
steps: UAT Café → Hardware → Add hardware: S - Tablet ×1, price ₹12,000 over 12 months, a serial number. New invoice with 'Add the hardware instalments due' ticked.
tests.expected: The invoice has a hardware line of ₹1,000. The restaurant shows '1 of 12 billed'. Cancelling that invoice makes the instalment due again.

tests.title: Payments page and overview
steps: Payments and Overview.
tests.expected: This month's total matches the payments recorded. Overview counts and 'needs attention' match the restaurant list.

tests.title: Log in as owner
steps: UAT Café → Log in as owner ↗.
tests.expected: Opens UAT Café signed in as owner, with a 'Support login by <name>' banner. Activity shows 'logged in as owner'.

tests.title: Create a Basic test restaurant
steps: Restaurants → New: 'S - Limit Test', address 's-limit-test', plan Basic, Free trial 14 days, owner 's_limit' with a password.
tests.expected: Created. Its owner can sign in.

tests.title: Table and staff limits
steps: As s_limit: add 15 tables, then a 16th. Add 5 staff (cashier/waiter/kitchen), then a 6th. Add 1 manager, then a 2nd. Try a 2nd outlet.
tests.expected: Each extra one is refused with a message naming the limit (e.g. 'Cannot create more tables. Your Basic plan allows maximum 15…'). Note if any message names the wrong plan.

tests.title: Per-restaurant override
steps: SaaS admin → S - Limit Test → Edit → Limits: tables 20. Save. Owner adds the 16th table.
tests.expected: Now allowed. The limit shows as custom.

tests.title: Module not in plan
steps: As s_limit type /waiter/, /inventory/, /retail/, /points/. Scan one of its table QRs on a phone.
tests.expected: Staff see '<module> — This isn't part of your Basic plan. Contact us to add it.'; the sidebar has no link. Guests see 'Not available here'.

tests.title: Expiring soon
steps: Edit S - Limit Test: expiry = today + 3 days. Sign in as owner, and as a staff user.
tests.expected: Owner sees 'Your Basic plan renews on … (in 3 days)'. Staff don't.

tests.title: Grace period
steps: Set expiry = yesterday (grace 7 days).
tests.expected: Everyone sees the grace banner; the POS still works.

tests.title: Locked
steps: Set expiry = 10 days ago. Try the owner login, a table QR and a pay link.
tests.expected: Staff see 'Your subscription has ended… All your data is safe' with support phone/email, even on the login page. Guests see 'Not available right now'.

tests.title: Payment unlocks
steps: Record a payment of 1 month on S - Limit Test.
tests.expected: Paid-until moves to one month from today; the POS works again with no banner.

tests.title: Suspend and reactivate
steps: Account → Suspend with reason 'UAT pause'. Owner opens the POS. Reactivate.
tests.expected: 'Your account is paused' with the reason. Back to normal after Reactivate.

tests.title: Extend free
steps: Extend free by 30 days, then try 120.
tests.expected: 30 adds 30 days; over 90 is refused.

tests.title: Restaurant created from GreenCard
steps: Do this after GreenCard test GPOS-07. SaaS admin → Restaurants → find Paragon (address f-paragon).
tests.expected: Listed with the plan and paid-until set on GreenCard. Notes say 'Created from GreenCard'. Activity shows actor greencard.

tests.title: Trial from GreenCard
steps: After GPOS-02: find Café Lota.
tests.expected: Expiry = start + the plan's trial days. Notes say 'N-day trial started…'.

tests.title: Owner with no password
steps: Try to sign in to Café Lota's POS on /login/ with username cafelota.owner (or as shown in Owner logins) and any password.
Open the POS via GreenCard's Open POS → My Profile → set a password. Sign out and sign in with it.
tests.expected: No password works at first. After setting one in Profile (no current password asked), normal login works.

tests.title: Changes stay in step
steps: In SaaS admin change Paragon's paid-until date. Reload GreenCard Admin → POS and Paragon's POS page.
tests.expected: GreenCard shows the new date. Plan, status and dates always match on both sides.

tests.title: No sales data leaves the POS
steps: Make 2 orders in Paragon's POS. Look at every GreenCard POS screen (admin and restaurant).
tests.expected: GreenCard shows plan, status, staff/outlet counts and billing only — never orders, sales totals or customers.

sections.name: Full café day (do together at the end)

tests.title: A full day at UAT Café
steps: Sana = owner/cashier, Fathima = waiter, Mithra = kitchen and guests (phone).
1. Cashier opens the drawer and starts a shift.
2. Two guests order by QR on T1 and T2; one waiter order on T3 with seat bills.
3. Kitchen prepares and bumps by station; waiter serves; T1 adds a second round.
4. T1 pays cash at the counter, T2 pays online with a tip, T3 splits by seat (one UPI, one card).
5. Cash out ₹100 for supplies; owner adds an expense.
6. Cashier ends the shift and closes the drawer.
7. Owner checks Reports and Collections PDF.
tests.expected: Every table ends Vacant, every order Completed, and the Collections totals, shift cash and reports agree with each other to the rupee.
